experience.title: Professional path
experience.description: A journey across content, product, digital projects, and communities, where I bring together language, research, and data to design better experiences.
itemsHtml:
2021 — 2026

Tiendanube

Content Strategist

I designed content strategies and digital experiences at Tiendanube, focusing on acquisition and conversion journeys. I worked on landing pages, flows, microcopy, in-app experiences, and organic channels.

I combined research, behavioral analysis, usability testing, and A/B tests to identify friction and iterate on solutions. I led SEO strategy and CRO initiatives in collaboration with teams.

Key takeaway: a holistic view of content as part of the product, connecting people’s needs, data, and business.

2017 — 2021

Organization of Ibero-American States (OEI)

Technical project manager

I managed Cooperation and Innovation projects related to education and culture. I coordinated activities, tracked budgets, prepared reports on results, and organized in-person and virtual events.

Key takeaway: tools for managing complex projects, bringing teams together, and communicating clearly with different stakeholders.

2017 — 2021

Corear Video Game Music Orchestra

Community Manager

I led the orchestra’s content, social media, communications, and press strategy. I developed content for different platforms and analyzed results to optimize reach, boost engagement, and strengthen the community.

Key takeaway: I learned to connect narrative, audience, and brand, as well as use data to strengthen communities.

approach.title: From content to implementation
approach.description: Beyond designing content, I can turn an idea into a functional prototype and publish it. That’s how I built this bilingual portfolio, bringing together UX decisions, writing, and AI-assisted development.
itemsHtml:
I work with code

I use the terminal, VS Code, Git, and GitHub to iterate on projects and review changes through pull requests.

I structure content

I work with HTML, CSS, Markdown, and JSON to shape interfaces and structured content.

I prototype and publish

I use Codex or Lovable to develop and iterate, and Firebase Hosting to publish web projects.
